const data = $json.studentData; const message = $json.counselorMessage; const matches = $json.matchedUniversities; const formatUni = (u) => `
  • ${u.name}
    📍 ${u.city}, ${u.country}
    ✨ Match Score: ${u.score}/100 | Acceptance: ${u.acceptance_rate}%
    • `; const emailBody = `

    🎓 Your University Counselor Report

    Welcome, ${data.personalInfo.name}! Here's your personalized guidance.

    📚 Counselor's Message

    ${message.replace(/\n/g, '
    ')}

    🎯 Your Matched Universities

    Safe Universities

      ${matches.safe.map(formatUni).join('')}

    Target Universities

      ${matches.target.map(formatUni).join('')}

    Dream Universities

      ${matches.dream.map(formatUni).join('')}

    📊 Your Profile

    Academic Score: ${data.academics.academicScore} (${data.academics.gradingSystem})

    Study Level: ${data.preferences.studyLevel}

    Target Countries: ${data.preferences.targetCountries.join(', ')}

    Budget: $${data.preferences.budgetMin} - $${data.preferences.budgetMax}

    Match Maker Path Student Counselor

    `; return { emailBody };
